title: Ridges
description: The ridges design tool: the presets its drawing saves, each a whole setup of palettes, dials, seed and frame. The drawing itself is a layout kept on the map.

types.title: Ridges preset
types.description: A saved setup of the ridges design tool, as its Presets menu keeps it: the item's name is the preset's name, its setup the whole of it.

setup.description: The whole setup as the ridges drawing saved it: palettes, dials, seed, frame, name, letter, emblem. Loaded from the Presets menu of the Ridges drawing.
